lines.text: pick one thread that carries through (an object, a type line, a colour or a rhythm), not separate reveals one after another
lines.card: One thread carries through

lines.text: choose the hero on purpose, not an attractor: a glowing circle or orb, a dusk sun or crescent, a light-poetry name like Vesper
lines.card: an attractor (the list below) the direction did not choose

lines.text: draw three directions from different materials (type, paper, liquid, cut geometry, photograph, UI, light), not three colours of one idea; at most one is light
lines.card: at most one of three directions made of light

lines.text: show the subject by 0.1 s, not an empty ground for the first half second
lines.card: Never an empty ground for the first 0.5 s.

lines.text: turn the world every 1 to 2 s (a new element, a cut, a ground swap), not one lockup held
lines.card: Turn the world every 1–2 beats

lines.text: give each frame one focal point and one accent colour, not two things fighting
lines.card: one focal point per frame, one accent colour per frame

lines.text: use the kit's face and ground or a face the direction chose, not Inter or Space Grotesk by habit
lines.card: never Inter or Space Grotesk without a brand reason

lines.text: enter on a strong ease-out and exit shorter and accelerating, not an exit as long as its entrance
lines.card: exits run shorter and accelerate

lines.text: take curves from curveToLinear or a sampled spring, not a cubic-bezier sold as an exponential
lines.card: one `cubic-bezier` sold as an exponential

lines.text: put each move in a speed band with the slowest 3x the fastest, not every move at one duration
lines.card: the slowest beat runs at least 3x the fastest

lines.text: stagger a group 30 to 80 ms, not a group that lands on one frame
lines.card: never a group that lands on one frame

lines.text: change axis or direction at every seam, not the same seam move twice
lines.card: never the same seam move twice

lines.text: cut, wipe on the motion or match a shape, not a muddy crossfade
lines.card: never a crossfade as the only transition

lines.text: make each entrance a move with an origin, not everything fading in
lines.card: Never everything fading in

lines.text: use a stock device (sheen band, lens streak, light beam, accent bar, rule line) once, not as the idea
lines.card: a stock device (sheen band, lens streak, light beam, accent bar, rule line) at most once per film

lines.text: use quiet ticks (droplet, pluck, bloom) at their default gains, not impact, braam, drop or riser without a brief that asks for weight
lines.card: Never impact, braam, drop or riser unless the brief asks for weight

lines.text: use at most one soft swell that ends on a cut, not a whoosh on every cut
lines.card: never a whoosh on every cut

lines.text: keep the true peak at or below -10 dBFS and the mix near -20 LUFS, not a mix pushed loud
lines.card: true peak at or below -10 dBFS

lines.text: cue the first and the last key word, not a tick on every word
lines.card: quiet ticks

lines.text: tie each cue to one visible event, not sound for its own sake
lines.card: name what each device points at

lines.text: check the frame at 0.1 s has the subject, not an empty ground
lines.card: Frame at 0.1 s has a subject.

lines.text: end on motion in the last 1 s, not a frozen lockup
lines.card: never a static frame in the last 1 s

lines.text: let every mark ride its parent, not a mark that points at nothing
lines.card: never a mark that points at nothing

lines.text: pad each reveal mask 0.3 em past the glyphs, not letters cut by their own reveal
lines.card: Never letters cut by their own reveal.

lines.text: set a read line at a 6% cap height and hold it max(1.2 s, words/3), not a small tagline that flashes by
lines.card: a cap height of at least 6% of frame height

lines.text: keep the accent on one thing, not a full-frame flood
lines.card: Never a full-frame cobalt flood as the ground

lines.text: keep gradients clean with 1 to 2% grain, not banding rings or a straight seam in a glow
lines.card: no banding rings
